title: Activation Contingency Lighthouse and Capacity Playtest
summary: Operational playtest and contingency checklist for a staged product activation. Focused on validating capacity assumptions, exercising circuit breakers and rollback paths, and establishing KPI signals for go/no-go decisions.
content:
Context:
This is a lightweight playbook to run a focused capacity playtest tied to launch "lighthouse" scenarios. The goal is to validate the traffic shaping, autoscale and fallback behaviors for the next feature activation window, capture KPIs, and rehearse contingency responses across product, SRE, and ops. This doc is intentionally pragmatic: short scripts, measurable exit criteria, and clear owners for each signal.

Objective:
- Verify that Dedicated/Ghost routing, cache warming, and batch profiles meet latency and cost targets under a controlled ramp.
- Confirm circuit breakers, model-fallback and region-fallback operate without data loss.
- Produce a KPI packet (5 slides + data CSV) for the 2/20 readiness sync and recommend go/no-go.

Scope (what we will test):
- Traffic shapes: 1) smoke (10 RPS), 2) ramp (peak 350 RPS sustained for 10m), 3) endurance (burst 10m / steady 60m)
- Models: primary (redwood-opt-13b), fallback quantized variant (opt-13b-q4), and small short-context model for graceful degrade.
- Regions: us-west1 primary, eu-west1 backup.
- Surface: API gen endpoint + streaming enabled route.

Primary success KPIs (measured per-phase):
- P95 latency (online tokens): smoke < 120ms, ramp < 250ms, endurance < 350ms
- Error rate (5xx + model errors): < 0.5% during ramp; < 1% during endurance
- Token cost delta vs baseline: no more than +18% for fallback behavior under sustained load
- Autoscale reaction time: new worker readiness < 60s after scale signal
- Route failover time (primary -> fallback): <= 15s and no request duplication
- Customer-visible degradation window: < 30s for streaming sessions (graceful close/fallback)

Playtest phases and owners:
1) Pre-check (owner: Maya) — checklist to run 2 business days before playtest
   - Confirm load harness config + credentials (Jenkins job: load/playtest-run)
   - Verify canary model build uploaded (artifact id in linked_artifacts)
   - Telemetry hooks added to route (OpenTelemetry spans + logs)
   - Slack bridge active (#prod-ops-runway) and pager oncall assigned

2) Smoke (owner: Ravi) — 15 minutes
   - Run 10 RPS with 50% short prompts + 50% long prompts
   - Validate p95 latency < 120ms, no 5xxs
   - Snapshot logs, tracer traces for first 10m

3) Ramp (owner: Liam) — 30 minutes
   - Gradually increase to 350 RPS over 6 minutes and sustain for 10 minutes
   - Observe autoscale and batching behavior, record worker counts every 30s
   - Intentionally trigger primary model OOM after 6m to force fallback; measure failover time
   - Run lightweight A/B quality probe against baseline prompts (5 prompts set)

4) Endurance & Surge (owner: Sofia) — 75 minutes
   - Run steady 60m test with occasional 10m bursts at 650 RPS
   - Validate KV cache hit ratio, token cost, and cold-start tail latency
   - Confirm circuit breaker thresholds do not cascade into region-level failover unless intended

5) Post-mortem dry-run (everyone) — immediate 30m debrief
   - Capture preliminary KPI deck: latency distribution, errors, cost, autoscale timeline, failover timeline
   - Draft initial remediation tickets and owners

Circuit breakers & rollback triggers (explicit):
- If 5xx rate > 1% for > 5 minutes -> Pause rollout, scale-inhibit and revert traffic to baseline model version. (Trigger: PRODOPS-ROLLBACK-01)
- If P95 latency > 400ms for > 3 minutes -> enable route-level rate-limiters and engage SRE runbook.
- If token cost > 30% above baseline for sustained 20m -> throttle non-essential routes and open cost-review channel.
- If region failover exceeds 30s or duplicates requests -> abort test and collect heap/dump for model infra.

Instrumentation & data collection plan:
- Required metrics: per-route token count, per-model pod CPU/GPU utilization, p50/p95/p99 latency (gen tokens), 5xx counts, cache hit ratio, worker counts, autoscale events.
- Logs: request ids, model variant id, KV cache keys (hashed), routing decision tags.
- Saved artifacts: request traces (one-per-100), full worker metrics CSV, cost estimate snapshot.
- Export locations: /mnt/playtests/activation-lighthouse/2025-02-18/ (SRE will mirror to BigQuery)

Communication / Escalation matrix:
- Slack: #prod-ops-runway (all updates), #sre-oncall (pager), #eng-sr-leads for technical escalation
- Pager: oncall SRE (Ravi) for infra issues; oncall SE (Liam) for routing/model builds
- Exec pulse: 10-min summary to PM & Eng Director if any circuit breaker triggers

Go/No-go criteria for next-day broader rollout:
- All primary success KPIs met during Ramp and Endurance phases.
- No untriaged 5xx incidents older than 24h.
- Quality A/B probe shows no regression in acceptance rate (> 98%) vs baseline.
- Incident playbooks validated and owners assigned for all triggered issues.

Artifacts to deliver after run:
- KPI packet: 5-slide deck + CSV (latency by percentile, error list, cost delta) (owner: Maya)
- Runbook updates: add any discovered thresholds to the runbook (owner: Ravi)
- Follow-up tickets: list with owner and target ETA (owner: Liam)

Open questions / known unknowns:
- Need an exact mapping of model-variant ids to rollout tags (SRE to confirm).
- Does the Dedicated pool allow instant pre-warming for the ramp phase (billing implications)? Product to confirm cost approval.
- How to surface streaming-session partial output vs forced fallback in customer metrics (product + analytics action).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Maya: finalize harness JSON and schedule Jenkins run (T-2 days)
- Ravi: verify telemetry export paths and ensure OTel sampling is configured
- Liam: prepare A/B prompts set and golden baseline responses (5 canonical prompts)
- Sofia: draft post-run KPI deck template and CSV schema

Notes / scratchpad (raw):
- Consider adding a small synthetic user cohort for regression (10 users with long-context dialogues)
- Potential follow-on: run the same sequence against Private deployment to validate network gating
- Keep communication lean during the run—one person posts phase transitions and one thread for issues

Related tickets / refs:
- PRODOPS-312 (playtest orchestration)
- INFRA-884 (autoscale tuning work)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7890 (playtest harness changes)
